proposition: Timeline A.1 dates R. al-Inzāliyya, R. Anjām, R. Bāʾiyya, R. Nuqṭa and R. Muḥammadiyya to 828/1425 with the caveat 'writes (or has copied)' and a query on Yazd, and R. Shaqq-i Qamar, R. Suʾl al-Mulūk (for Bāysunghur) and Sharḥ al-Basmala (copies to Ulugh Beg and Qāżīzāda Rūmī) to 829/1426.
